title: Casting record
description: The per-dispatch attestation row (P15 + §7.3 standing telemetry): what was requested, what actually served the turn, and what it cost. requested_casting vs served_model is the substitution detector — a mismatch is a routing incident (P15), re-run and check whether any verdict was issued against substituted output.

served_model.description: Where exposed; the literal UNKNOWN otherwise

served_model_mismatch.description: True when served_model is known and differs from requested_casting.model — a P15 routing incident. COMPUTED, not schema-enforced (ruling 4, WO-8): the Verifier's artifact validation recomputes served_model vs requested_casting.model whenever served_model is not UNKNOWN, and refuses a record that contradicts or omits a computable mismatch

bucket.description: Which allowance bucket the call drew from (e.g. AU-S, AU-O, AU-F, OU)

draw_estimate.description: AU or OU per the bucket

review_cross_family.description: dispatcher-set; a mandatory-class change closed with false is an incident, not a tripwire (§3.4)

escape.description: Set later, when a defect the review missed surfaces
